procedure: Bind selected sections to current accepted arguments and metrics.
Write expert prose preserving evidence meaning and conclusion limits.
Attach passage-level evidence, metric and exhibit bindings without new numbers.
Return the draft, editorial record and unsupported-content work.

acceptance.expectation: Every displayed metric resolves to a current metric ID and authorized display value; other numeric facts resolve to supplied fact/event IDs.
Material passages and exhibits map to accepted arguments and exact current source/model locators; input acceptance and review records are not fabricated.
Prose serves the expert reader without new analysis, stronger unsupported conclusions, lost qualifications, invented board events or calculation changes.

conditions: Required source or execution tool unavailable
Acceptance test fails or remains unperformed
failure.record: failure_records; identify affected record, evidence/test, consequence, next action and conclusion restriction
